method: One focused native Playwright WebKit run on standard GitHub-hosted macos-15-intel (x64). Foreground WebKit, existing iPhone project defaults plus explicit 390/800/1440 viewport checks; not physical Safari/iPhone testing. No full suite, paid larger runner or production smoke.
